frontier-race.status: Frontier labs have rolled out several major models and applications: Mistral previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter Large 4 multimodal model, OpenAI released a fast Decisions API with voice and visual capabilities, and Microsoft’s Diagnostic Orchestrator demonstrated 83% accuracy on complex medical simulations. Deployments continue across industry, from Volkswagen Copilot to Gemini navigation in cars, while benchmark studies show modest gains in robot manipulation and multimodal reasoning.

Sweden’s government ministries have banned the use of ChatGPT and Claude, requiring Microsoft Copilot as the only approved AI tool for official work. These actions illustrate differing national approaches to AI governance.

india-ai.status: India has formalised a defence AI trustworthiness framework focused on reliability, safety and transparency. A 20 MW AI supercluster using AMD Instinct GPUs is operating in Chennai, providing on‑premise compute for Indian labs and enterprises. Domestic AI capabilities are expanding with Chariot’s real‑time speech‑to‑text model for ten Indian languages and LTM’s BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab, while Poland has announced plans for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India, to be discussed at the 2027 Global Investors Meet.

agent-safety.status: Meta has paused the Muse conversation‑sharing feature after 6,800 public links exposed data. Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents and the ARTEX framework to breach ConnectWise, compromising credentials for about 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants, and the company is working to restore its cloud backup service. Recent safety research includes mixed RLVR training results, the new EpiSEM‑Bench benchmark, OpenAI’s partnership with Poland’s NASK, US banks blocking third‑party AI agents, and Anthropic’s Claude generating formal security proofs for 123 open‑source libraries.

ai-money.status: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio and is working to embed its drug‑discovery AI agents into the Rosalind model and Workbench. The company is negotiating a private funding round of up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of a planned IPO. Warp Sciences raised $215 million to build AI‑powered drug research labs, and Pathos AI announced a $237 million Series E round and a multi‑year partnership with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI on Alzheimer research.

ai-infrastructure.status: NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure now includes Confidential Bare Metal deployment, GA of Vera Rubin A5X instances, and broad adoption of open‑weight models across European government, finance, retail, weather and industrial sectors. DSX and Minerva platforms are being rolled out to integrate power and compute, while large‑scale compute installations are active in India (Vultr 20 MW supercluster) and Kazakhstan (45,000 Grace GPUs). European sovereign AI clouds and industrial edge AI agents are expanding, and SpaceX is targeting 13 GW of AI compute by the end of 2027.
